name: ${name}
description: A market terminal for Hypixel SkyBlock: live bazaar and auction prices, price history charts, craft and forge profit rankings, and a configurable price HUD. Client-side and informational only - it shows public market data, it does not automate anything. Not an official Minecraft product. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel or Mojang. Live prices from the Hypixel API; price history and auction listings from SkyCofl (https://sky.coflnet.com/data); recipe and NPC shop data from the NotEnoughUpdates repository (MIT). Bundles MoulConfig (LGPL-3.0), which includes LibNinePatch (MPL-2.0); both licences travel in the jar.
